purpose: Authoritative index of the real protected Member Resource Library resources. Governance document only: it is not read by the Library application at runtime and changes no behaviour.
governance: The Member Resource Library remains a separate protected application from the OffGrid056 OS.
The Library does not share OS cookies.
The Library does not share OS session tokens.
The Library does not share OS localStorage.
The Library does not share OS household state.
The Library does not depend on OS authentication records.
The OS must not write Library saved, progress or member state; Library state remains Library-owned.
OS recommendations must use the stable resource ID.
OS recommendations must use approved Library metadata.
The OS must not guess Library URLs.
The OS must not proxy protected Library content.
Authentication is not entitlement; Cloudflare authentication must not imply entitlement.
Entitlement remains a separate future contract.
Recommendation handoff remains inactive until that contract is approved.
The Library remains the visual brand reference for OffGrid056.
No OS, Supabase, Railway or Cloudflare infrastructure change is part of the Library programme stages that maintain this index.

definitions.status: technical / build-state gate (draft, published, archived): decides whether a build loads the record; unchanged
definitions.publicationStatus: editorial / publication governance state (draft, review, approved, live, withdrawn, superseded, internal)
definitions.migrationState: migration workflow state in the operational registers (Not started, Prepared, Staged, Deployed/LIVE, Blocked, Merged)
definitions.accessProtection: whether access protection exists (Cloudflare Access on the preview hostname)
definitions.entitlementRequirement: whether the member is entitled to receive a resource (undefined until the owner defines it)
definitions.rule: These six concepts stay separate and are never derived from one another.

rulings.publicationModel: APPROVED: keep `status` as the technical/build gate; add the separate future fields `publicationStatus` and `releaseChannel`; do not merge the concepts. Not implemented: no record, build or badge changed.

currentThirtyResources.meaning: Protected private-preview resources. NOT public, NOT a production-member release, NOT a paid entitlement, NOT OS entitlement, NOT an OS authentication handoff.

visibleBadge.tooltip: Approved resource in the protected OffGrid056 preview.
visibleBadge.tooltipRule: Exact approved wording; used unless a technical constraint requires a minor punctuation or capitalisation change. It must not imply public release, production entitlement, paid access or a final member launch, and 'not yet approved for members' is not used for the approved private-preview state.
visibleBadge.implemented: DEPLOYED (Stage 10.19C): the 30 live protected resources show Preview on the resource detail page; the staged resource res-1024 will show it when deployed.

rulings.accessAndEntitlement: No free or paid tier is assigned. accessTier and entitlementRequirement stay UNDEFINED_OWNER_DECISION on all 30. Authentication must not be treated as entitlement.
rulings.res1002FileName: KEEP AS-IS. household-risk-identifier.pdf stays; recorded as a known legacy naming exception (route and download work, no member-facing defect, a rename adds deployment risk). No correction stage is required for this filename alone.
rulings.res1025: REVIEW LATER. The resource stays live and unchanged; a dedicated wording review is a future task, kept separate from the publication-model implementation.
rulings.res1027AndRes1510: KEEP BOTH. res-1027 is the standard implementation roadmap and res-1510 the advanced roadmap; the near-duplicate title is intentional. No merge, rename or retirement.
rulings.metadataPolicy: owner, version, versionDate, reviewStatus and lastReviewedDate are now recorded. Where current project evidence cannot establish a value the marker UNKNOWN_EXISTING_RECORD is used; no date or version is fabricated. For new or reviewed resources going forward these fields are mandatory.
rulings.reviewStatusModel: Retained. A resource cannot be VERIFIED_CURRENT until the required canonical fields (version, versionDate, sourceLink, entitlement) are supported; missing values stay visible as unresolved metadata.
rulings.publicRepositoryHygiene: REVIEW REQUIRED in a separate security/hygiene stage. Nothing is removed or rewritten now; the repository visibility is not changed. The later review should assess internal/, admin-import/, Worker IDs, Access hostnames, account email references, local file paths and historical operational notes. The Stage 10.19 scan found no credential-like value, which does not establish that the repository is clean.

implementation.fields: publicationStatus and releaseChannel added to the resource schema (optional, declared together, enum-validated); `status` unchanged as the build gate.
implementation.badgeLogic: lib/content/publication.ts: approved + private-preview => Preview with the exact tooltip; every other, missing or unrecognised combination => no badge (fail closed). The build validator and verify-build fail a real resource whose pair is not owner-approved.
implementation.detailPage: PublicationBadge on the resource detail page
implementation.obligation: Any new resource staged from now on must carry an owner-approved publicationStatus + releaseChannel in its record, or the build fails.
